gameplayAdaptations: Derived directly from the real Upper Middle Rhine Gorge DEM at the Lorelei bend (St. Goarshausen, ~68 m river level to ~200+ m slate cliffs).
Symbolic Grail Hall story pavilion is placed as an explicitly labeled literary structure on the upper terrace, cleanly separated from the verified Rhine gorge geography.
